overview.title: Crocodiles and Gardens South of Town
overview.p1: Crocoparc is a purpose-built attraction south of Agadir: Nile crocodiles, landscaped gardens and a clear family itinerary. It will not replace the beach or the Kasbah, but it fills a half-day when you need something structured and shaded.
overview.p2: Check current ticket prices and opening hours before you go. Plan transport in advance — it sits outside the main hotel strip.
overview.p3: Works well with children or as a break from pure beach days. Pair with a quiet evening on the corniche afterward.

1.desc: The animals that give the park its name.

food.p1: On-site options cover snacks; a better meal waits back in Agadir.
food.p2: Do not expect destination dining inside the park.

q1.question: How long do I need?
q1.answer: About 2–3 hours for a full circuit without rushing.

q2.question: Is it only for children?
q2.answer: No, but families are the core audience.

q3.question: Tickets?
q3.answer: Buy on site or online when available — confirm the day’s price.

q4.question: Do I need a guide at Crocoparc?
q4.answer: Optional for a simple visit; useful for context and timing.

q5.question: Is Crocoparc suitable for families?
